title: Accept CLUSTALW as a Clustal header word
body:
Closes #5355

- [X] I hereby agree to dual licence this and any previous contributions under both
the _Biopython License Agreement_ **AND** the _BSD 3-Clause License_.

- [X] I have read the ``CONTRIBUTING.rst`` file, have run ``pre-commit``
locally, and understand that continuous integration checks will be used to
confirm the Biopython unit tests and style checks pass with these changes.

- [X] I have added my name to the alphabetical contributors listings in the files
``NEWS.rst`` and ``CONTRIB.rst`` as part of this pull request, am listed
already, or do not wish to be listed. (*This acknowledgement is optional.*)

Some tools (Benchling, per the issue) write the Clustal header as a single word, `CLUSTALW`, rather than `CLUSTAL W`. Both the `Bio.AlignIO` and `Bio.Align` Clustal parsers reject that with `ValueError: CLUSTALW is not a known CLUSTAL header`.

This adds `CLUSTALW` to the known-program list in both parsers, as suggested in the issue discussion, with a test for each.

Tested: the two new tests fail on master and pass with the change; `test_AlignIO_ClustalIO`, `test_Align_clustal`, `test_AlignIO`, `test_SeqIO` pass; `pre-commit` is clean.

linked_issue.title: AlignIO.read fails with ClustalW header
linked_issue.body:
Some programs/software use `CLUSTALW` in the header of a clustal file (e.g. Benchling), as opposed to the more common `CLUSTAL W`. `CLUSTALW` is not recognized as a valid clustal header by `AlignIO.read(format='clustal')`.

The following file `test.clustal` raises a value error
```
CLUSTALW

Seq1   A 1
Seq2   A 1
```

```
from Bio import AlignIO
AlignIO.read('test.clustal', format='clustal')
```
```
ValueError: CLUSTALW is not a known CLUSTAL header: CLUSTAL, PROBCONS, MUSCLE, MSAPROBS, Kalign, Biopython
```

This could possibly be fixed by checking whether the header begins with `"CLUSTAL"`
```
diff --git a/Bio/AlignIO/ClustalIO.py b/Bio/AlignIO/ClustalIO.py
index 69499c7b1..0eb6b0e39 100644
--- a/Bio/AlignIO/ClustalIO.py
+++ b/Bio/AlignIO/ClustalIO.py
@@ -119,7 +119,7 @@ class ClustalIterator(AlignmentIterator):
             "Kalign",
             "Biopython",
         ]
-        if line.strip().split()[0] not in known_headers:
+        if line.strip().split()[0] not in known_headers and line.strip().split()[0][0:7] != 'CLUSTAL':
             raise ValueError(
                 "%s is not a known CLUSTAL header: %s"
                 % (line.strip().split()[0], ", ".join(known_headers))

```
